ws.overview.sub.en: Choose titles for the US, manage advertising, and review audience response.
ws.overview.sub.zh: 筛选美国发行作品、管理广告活动、查看受众反应。

ws.overview.recommendedSub.en: Review each title’s market evidence or continue its advertising campaign.
ws.overview.recommendedSub.zh: 查看各作品的市场依据，或继续处理广告活动。

ws.overview.decisionsSub.en: Open a campaign to complete its next step.
ws.overview.decisionsSub.zh: 打开广告活动，完成下一步。

ws.score.note.en: A rules-based index combining market relevance, readiness and available results. It is not a measure of American audience appeal.
ws.score.note.zh: 按规则综合市场相关性、准备度和已有结果，不代表美国受众喜爱程度。

ws.fact.noTropes.en: No story tags recognized: the synopsis is missing or too short.
ws.fact.noTropes.zh: 未识别出题材标签：简介缺失或太短。

ws.fact.tropes.en: {n} story tags matched against the prominent-listing mix
ws.fact.tropes.zh: {n} 个题材标签与显著作品构成对照

ws.fact.comparables.zh: {n} 部可比作品，平均显著度 {prominence}

ws.fact.hotTropes.en: {n} of its tags are among the ten most prominent story types
ws.fact.hotTropes.zh: {n} 个标签位列十大显著题材

ws.fact.noHotTropes.en: None of its tags are among the ten most prominent story types
ws.fact.noHotTropes.zh: 没有标签位列十大显著题材

ws.fact.noHistory.en: Collecting history: chart movement needs a second observation day
ws.fact.noHistory.zh: 积累历史中：榜单变化需要第二个采集日

ws.fact.tropeDelta.en: Its story types moved {pts} pts in chart share since the previous day
ws.fact.tropeDelta.zh: 其题材的榜单占比较上一采集日变化 {pts} 点

ws.fact.rightsOk.zh: 美国授权窗口覆盖今天（至 {end}）

ws.fact.rightsExpiring.zh: 授权窗口 90 天内到期（{end}）

ws.fact.subsApproved.zh: {n} 集已有定稿英文字幕（共 {total} 集）

ws.fact.subsPartial.zh: 英文改编完成 {pct}%，尚未定稿

ws.fact.scriptsOnly.en: {n} episodes uploaded as scripts only, no video
ws.fact.scriptsOnly.zh: 已上传 {n} 集剧本，无视频

ws.fact.destinationOk.en: A destination URL is set on a campaign
ws.fact.destinationOk.zh: 广告活动已设置落地页

ws.fact.destinationMissing.en: No destination (landing page or platform link) recorded
ws.fact.destinationMissing.zh: 未记录落地页或平台链接

ws.fact.adAccountOk.en: A customer-owned ad account is connected
ws.fact.adAccountOk.zh: 已连接客户自有广告账户

ws.fact.adAccountInvited.en: Ad account access invited, not yet accepted
ws.fact.adAccountInvited.zh: 广告账户已邀请授权，尚未接受

ws.fact.noReports.en: No imported US performance for this title
ws.fact.noReports.zh: 此作品没有导入的美国表现数据

ws.fact.results.zh: 最佳广告：3 秒留存 {hold}%（基准 {benchHold}%），点击率 {ctr}%（基准 {benchCtr}%）

ws.fact.resultsDemo.en: Demo results only, counted at half: hook hold {hold}% (benchmark {benchHold}%), CTR {ctr}% (benchmark {benchCtr}%)
ws.fact.resultsDemo.zh: 仅演示结果，按一半计：3 秒留存 {hold}%（基准 {benchHold}%），点击率 {ctr}%（基准 {benchCtr}%）

ws.fact.testPending.en: A test exists but has no results yet

ws.fact.china.en: China: completion {completion}%, paying {paying}% (context only, no points)
ws.fact.china.zh: 国内：完播 {completion}%，付费 {paying}%（仅供参考，不计分）

ws.fact.targetsUS.en: The US is a stated target market
ws.fact.targetsUS.zh: 美国是你声明的目标市场

ws.fact.notUS.en: The US is not among your stated target markets
ws.fact.notUS.zh: 美国不在你声明的目标市场中

ws.fact.profileOverlap.en: {n} of its tags match the story types you say you produce
ws.fact.profileOverlap.zh: {n} 个标签与你声明的主要题材重合

ws.raise.synopsis.en: Add a synopsis so the title can be tagged

ws.raise.history.en: Turns on automatically after the next market crawl
ws.raise.history.zh: 下次市场采集后自动启用

ws.raise.subtitles.en: Finalize English subtitles for at least two episodes
ws.raise.subtitles.zh: 至少定稿两集英文字幕

ws.raise.destination.en: Set a destination URL on the campaign
ws.raise.destination.zh: 在广告活动中设置落地页

ws.raise.adAccount.zh: 连接客户自有广告账户

ws.raise.test.zh: 准备一次 100 美元广告测试

ws.raise.finishTest.en: Complete the ad test and review results
ws.raise.finishTest.zh: 完成广告测试并查看结果

ws.next.renew.en: Renew or extend the license before testing
ws.next.renew.zh: 测试前续签或延长授权

ws.next.test.zh: 准备一次 100 美元广告测试

ws.next.generate.en: Generate ads from the saved brief
ws.next.generate.zh: 根据已保存的简报生成广告

ws.next.review.en: Choose ads, then approve ads and budget
ws.next.review.zh: 选择广告，再批准广告和预算

ws.next.results.en: Review results and choose the next spend
ws.next.results.zh: 查看结果并决定下一步投入

ws.catalog.sub.en: Compare your titles, review market evidence, and manage their next launch steps.
ws.catalog.sub.zh: 比较剧库作品、查看市场依据，并处理下一步发行任务。

ws.catalog.empty.en: No titles yet. Add one to assess its US potential.
ws.catalog.empty.zh: 还没有作品。添加一部以评估其美国潜力。

ws.catalog.chinaNote.en: China numbers are partner-reported context, not US evidence.
ws.catalog.chinaNote.zh: 国内数据为合作方提供的参考，不是美国证据。

ws.assess.sub.en: Review the market comparisons, launch requirements and advertising activity for this title.
ws.assess.sub.zh: 查看这部作品的市场对标、发行条件和广告活动。

ws.assess.comparablesSub.en: Prominent listings sharing story tags with this title; prominence is within each platform.
ws.assess.comparablesSub.zh: 与本作品共享题材标签的显著作品；显著度为平台内相对值。

ws.assess.reports.en: Your US reports for this title

ws.exp.sub.en: Prepare, choose ads, approve ads and budget, launch, then review results.
ws.exp.sub.zh: 准备、选择广告、批准广告和预算、投放，再查看结果。

ws.exp.empty.en: No ad campaigns yet. Start from a title's US potential page.
ws.exp.empty.zh: 还没有广告活动。从作品的美国潜力页开始。

ws.exp.mock.en: No ad platform is connected. Briefs, ads and budget approvals are saved records. Launch uses a demo handoff and spends nothing.
ws.exp.mock.zh: 尚未连接广告平台。简报、广告和预算审批均有保存记录。投放采用演示交接，不产生支出。

ws.exp.briefSub.en: Set the budget, audience and test goal. Saving a change clears budget approval.
ws.exp.briefSub.zh: 设置预算、受众和测试目标。保存修改后需重新批准预算。

ws.exp.budgetNote.en: A brief, not a spending control. A provider connection enforces the cap and its minimums.
ws.exp.budgetNote.zh: 是计划金额，不是支出控制。接入投放平台后由平台执行上限与最低预算。

ws.exp.signal.views.zh: 视频观看与 3 秒留存

ws.exp.saved.zh: 简报已保存（v{version}）。预算审批已清除。

ws.exp.budgetApproved.zh: 预算 ${n} 已于 {at} 批准

ws.exp.approverOnly.en: Only the approver role can approve a budget.
ws.exp.approverOnly.zh: 只有审批角色可以批准预算。

ws.exp.selectBatch.en: Choose {n} of {total} ads for the first test, then approve the ads.
ws.exp.selectBatch.zh: 从 {total} 条广告中选择 {n} 条用于首轮测试，再批准广告。

ws.exp.resultsSub.en: Per ad, for the window shown. Demo results are labelled and count at half in the assessment.
ws.exp.resultsSub.zh: 按广告和所示时间窗统计。演示结果有标注，在评估中按一半计。

ws.exp.noResults.en: No results yet. Results arrive from the launch system after submission.
ws.exp.noResults.zh: 还没有结果。提交后由投放系统回传。

ws.exp.simulateNote.en: Fixture mode only: generates demo-labelled numbers so the decision loop can be exercised.
ws.exp.simulateNote.zh: 仅演示模式：生成带标注的演示数据，用于走通决策流程。

ws.exp.benchmark.en: Benchmarks: hook hold {hold}%, CTR {ctr}%. Above both = worth more spend.
ws.exp.benchmark.zh: 基准：3 秒留存 {hold}%，点击率 {ctr}%。两项都高于基准 = 值得追加投入。

ws.exp.decideSub.en: Review the best ad and decide the next test. Your choice creates a new round.
ws.exp.decideSub.zh: 查看最佳广告并决定下一轮测试。你的选择将创建新一轮活动。

ws.exp.noWinner.en: No ad beat both benchmarks. Test new ads before spending more.
ws.exp.noWinner.zh: 没有广告同时超过两项基准。追加投入前先测试新广告。

ws.company.sub.en: Your goals, the accounts you own, who can act, billing, and your imported reports.
ws.company.sub.zh: 公司目标、你拥有的账户、操作权限、结算方式，以及导入的报表。

ws.company.goalHint.en: One sentence. Shown on the overview.

ws.accounts.sub.en: You own the accounts, billing and assets. Studio records the state you report and asks for revocable partner access; it never creates accounts or holds passwords.
ws.accounts.sub.zh: 账户、结算与素材归你所有。Studio 记录你报告的状态并申请可撤销的合作方权限；不会代你创建账户或保存密码。

ws.accounts.steps.en: TikTok setup: 1) the customer creates a Business Center and ad account under their own identity and payment method; 2) they invite Pulsar as a partner with ad-account access; 3) Studio records the invitation here and verifies once accepted. Access can be removed by the customer at any time.
ws.accounts.steps.zh: TikTok 设置：1）客户以自己的身份和支付方式创建商务中心和广告账户；2）邀请 Pulsar 为合作方并授予广告账户权限；3）Studio 在此记录邀请，接受后核实。客户可随时移除权限。

ws.access.rolesSub.en: Roles come from your company's Studio profiles.
ws.access.rolesSub.zh: 角色来自你公司的 Studio 成员资料。

ws.access.approver.en: Approver: approves ads and budgets, then authorizes launch
ws.access.approver.zh: 审批人：批准广告和预算，并授权投放

ws.access.reviewer.en: Reviewer: edits briefs, chooses ads and imports reports
ws.access.reviewer.zh: 审阅人：编辑简报、选择广告、导入报表

ws.billing.sub.en: Ad spend is billed by the platform to the customer's own payment method. Studio does not hold funds. Pulsar's service fee is invoiced separately.
ws.billing.sub.zh: 广告费用由平台向客户自己的支付方式结算。Studio 不代管资金。Pulsar 服务费另行开票。

ws.readOnly.en: Reviewer or approver roles can act here.
ws.readOnly.zh: 审阅或审批角色可以在此操作。

ws.card.noVideo.en: Video materials have not been uploaded
